 by Josh Austria

 Josh Austria 
 Aside from being a businessman, Josh Austria has been working…
 Gear up for one of the most anticipated online shopping events of the year! From November 6 to 15, 2026 , Xiaomi and POCO are rolling out massive savings across Shopee and Lazada for their 11.11 Mega Sale .
 Tech enthusiasts, gamers, families, and early holiday gift shoppers can enjoy unbeatable price drops, Free Shipping , Additional Discount Vouchers , and Buy Now Pay Later options across flagship smartphones, high-performance gaming rigs, tablets, smart home essentials, and wearables.
 The savings kick off on Shopee from November 6 to 15 and on Lazada from November 10 (8:00 PM) to November 15. Shoppers should set their alarms for the Peak Flash Sale Window starting November 10 at 8:00 PM through November 11 , where the biggest discounts of the season will drop.
